required_patterns.standalone-components: All Angular components must use the standalone component API with imports array instead of NgModules
required_patterns.signal-based-state: Component state should use Angular signals (signal()) for reactive values
required_patterns.primeng-components: UI components must use PrimeNG component library (imported from 'primeng/*' packages)
required_patterns.separate-template-style: Components should separate template (.html), styles (.css), and logic (.ts) into distinct files

architectural_constraints.component-structure: Components must follow the pattern: selector 'app-*', separate templateUrl and styleUrl, standalone: true implied by imports array
architectural_constraints.primeng-integration: All UI components must integrate with PrimeNG theme system configured in app.config.ts
architectural_constraints.typescript-strict-mode: All TypeScript code must compile with strict mode enabled (strict, noImplicitOverride, noImplicitReturns, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch)

required_patterns.angular-router: Use Angular Router with routes defined in app.routes.ts
required_patterns.spa-fallback: Backend must serve index.html for all non-API routes via MapFallbackToFile

architectural_constraints.route-definition: Routes must be defined as Routes array exported from app.routes.ts
architectural_constraints.router-outlet: Main app component must include <router-outlet> for route rendering
architectural_constraints.backend-routing: API routes should be prefixed or clearly distinguishable from SPA routes to prevent conflicts

required_patterns.primeng-themes: Use PrimeNG Aura theme preset configured via providePrimeNG in app.config.ts
required_patterns.component-scoped-styles: Component styles are scoped via Angular's ViewEncapsulation (default)

architectural_constraints.css-utilities: PrimeFlex CSS utility classes available for layout and spacing
architectural_constraints.theme-consistency: All components must respect PrimeNG theme configuration
architectural_constraints.no-inline-styles: Avoid inline styles; use CSS classes and component stylesheets

required_patterns.standalone-bootstrap: Application bootstraps using bootstrapApplication() with App component
required_patterns.app-config: Application configuration must be centralized in app.config.ts
required_patterns.provider-pattern: All providers (routing, animations, PrimeNG) configured via ApplicationConfig

architectural_constraints.zone-js: Application uses Zone.js with event coalescing enabled
architectural_constraints.animations: Browser animations provided asynchronously via provideAnimationsAsync()
architectural_constraints.error-handling: Global error listeners provided via provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners()

required_patterns.web-api-controllers: API endpoints implemented as ASP.NET Core API controllers with [ApiController] and [Route] attributes
required_patterns.dto-pattern: Data transfer objects (DTOs) for API request/response payloads
required_patterns.openapi-documentation: API documented via OpenAPI/Swagger (MapOpenApi() in development)

architectural_constraints.json-serialization: API uses System.Text.Json for JSON serialization
architectural_constraints.static-file-serving: Backend serves Angular static files from wwwroot via UseStaticFiles()

required_patterns.integrated-build: Angular app automatically built and copied to wwwroot during .NET build/publish
required_patterns.npm-integration: Build process runs 'npm install' and 'ng build --configuration production' as MSBuild targets

architectural_constraints.build-order: Frontend must build before backend publish to ensure wwwroot is populated
architectural_constraints.production-optimization: Production builds must use Angular's production configuration with optimization enabled

required_patterns.jasmine-karma: Unit tests use Jasmine framework with Karma test runner
required_patterns.testbed-configuration: Component tests use TestBed.configureTestingModule with component imports

architectural_constraints.standalone-testing: Tests must import standalone components directly in TestBed imports array
architectural_constraints.async-setup: beforeEach blocks should be async when configuring TestBed
architectural_constraints.fixture-pattern: Tests create fixtures via TestBed.createComponent and trigger change detection with fixture.detectChanges()

required_patterns.prettier: Code formatting via Prettier with Angular HTML parser
required_patterns.editorconfig: Editor configuration for consistent formatting across IDEs
required_patterns.vscode-integration: VS Code launch and task configurations for debugging and building

architectural_constraints.prettier-config: Prettier settings: printWidth 100, singleQuote true, Angular HTML parser
architectural_constraints.typescript-compiler: TypeScript target ES2022 with module preservation mode
